args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
Upgrades the fastjson pin from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

CVE-2026-31337 (high severity) affects fastjson <2.9.4 (and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0) via unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. 2.9.4 is the earliest fixed 2.x release.

CI passed on this branch.
